title: Exploration log
description: TOML front matter of an exploration log (explore/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.md); the body lists every fork as it is made. Specified in https://github.com/ASSERT-KTH/assert-research-agent/blob/main/CONVENTIONS.md.

schema.description: Mandatory: the URL of this schema, which leads back to the conventions.

holdout.description: Data reserved before the first look, for the confirmatory run.

data_seen.description: Every path looked at, kept current.
